text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to present the results of an investigation for a request to have an all-way stop control installed at the intersection of Richardson Avenue and Lester Avenue. A staff assessment has determined that although the technical warrant requirements for all-way stop controls are not achieved, the installation of all-way stop control is being recommended at the intersection to help improve traffic management and pedestrian safety at this location.
Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Authorized an all-way compulsory stop control at the intersection Richardson Avenue and Lester Avenue.
